summary: Houthi missile attacks triggered Saudi early warning systems across multiple western cities with smoke observed at Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport. Israeli drone strikes in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan neighborhood caused several injuries while Hezbollah explosive devices wounded two IDF soldiers in southern Lebanon. Iran is reportedly rebuilding a nuclear-linked military facility previously destroyed by Israeli bunker-buster bombs.

Israeli drone strike targeted a civilian vehicle in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan neighborhood resulting in several injuries. (Source: @presstv/207430)
Hezbollah roadside bomb hit an IDF engineering vehicle in southern Lebanon's buffer zone lightly injuring two soldiers prompting IDF strikes on Hezbollah infrastructure. (Source: @manniefabian/59190)
Israeli forces continue controlled detonations in the southern Lebanese town of Meiss El Jabal. (Source: @presstv/207434)
Satellite imagery indicates Iran is rapidly reconstructing a secret military facility linked to its nuclear program previously destroyed by Israeli bunker-buster bombs. (Source: @kianmeli1/92258)
Turkey revoked Iran's Bank Mellat banking license and suspended Mahan Air flights escalating economic pressure on Tehran. (Source: @shin_persian/10194)
Handala hacker group published selfies from 700 Israeli security personnel phones claiming infiltration of mobile devices. (Source: @presstv/207433)
Iranian National Security Council Secretary stated Trump's calculations on Iran were wrong and the war was instigated by Netanyahu. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/393201)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous Houthi missile barrage on Saudi Arabia and Hezbollah's roadside bombing in southern Lebanon indicate coordinated pressure from Iran's regional proxies. Israel's continued detonations in Lebanon and drone strikes in Gaza suggest a multi-front operational tempo that risks escalation. Iran's reconstruction of a nuclear-linked facility signals defiance despite Israeli kinetic setbacks, while Turkish financial sanctions add economic pressure. The Handala cyber operation demonstrates growing asymmetric capabilities targeting Israeli human intelligence networks.
sections.regional_response: Saudi early warning systems activated across five western cities demonstrating integrated air defense readiness against Houthi threats. Turkey's unprecedented revocation of an Iranian state bank license and flight suspensions marks a significant shift in Ankara-Tehran relations. Russia's request for Iranian wartime infrastructure protection experience suggests Moscow views Tehran's air defense lessons as valuable for its own conflict. The US Pentagon's acknowledged intelligence failures in the Minab strike reveal targeting process vulnerabilities.
sections.intelligence_notes: The convergence of kinetic attacks (Houthi missiles, Hezbollah IEDs), cyber operations (Handala hack), and diplomatic moves (Turkish sanctions, Russian interest) indicates a broadening conflict spectrum. Iran's facility reconstruction timeline suggests prioritization of nuclear infrastructure resilience. The IDF's buffer zone engineering vehicle targeting reveals Hezbollah's persistent surveillance and munition emplacement capabilities. Saudi siren activation across multiple governorates implies missile trajectory covering 800+ km range.
